title: What Is Your AI Agent Buying? Evaluation, Biases, Model Dependence, & Emerging Implications for Agentic E-Commerce

bias_targets.methodology: Randomizing the placement of products in visual grid layouts and headless JSON lists across multiple trials, then applying a conditional logit model to quantify the causal impact of rank and position on the AI shopping agent's selection.

Randomly assigning promotional tags such as 'Sponsored', 'Overall Pick', and scarcity labels to product listings, and using conditional logit regressions to measure how AI agents penalize or reward these markers.

Simulating fully AI-mediated e-commerce markets over thousands of trials with randomized positions to measure how frequently AI agents concentrate demand on a few 'modal' products or brands, ignoring overall consumer preference dispersion.
